title: T090 REAL existing Owner/Reporter identities and matching auth.sessions in isolated READ ONLY PostgreSQL RLS tests
source: Connected Supabase production project vrffsnkycvjithwtiylt via database read-only execution; no actual JWT access token, no user identities exported
method: BEGIN READ ONLY; DO SELECT existing public.user_roles, auth.sessions and active team_accounts into local variables; PERFORM set_config(request.jwt.claims, claims from real DB identity/session, true); SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated; SELECT ONLY privacy-safe booleans/counts; ROLLBACK
observations: Authenticated report-role claim declaring Owner AAL2 did not grant Owner; actual app role remains reporter
Owner under AAL1 cannot access Owner records
Authorized Owner AAL2 simulated claims plus existing session gives nonzero Owner data, providing a positive-control against vacuous zero-row tests

Nonexistent session blocks Owner-sensitive RLS despite owner user ID; Owner can still read one own user_roles record because users_can_read_own_role lacks private.current_session_active(), existing T087 identified this stale-session self-role metadata exception

finding.evidence: user_roles.users_can_read_own_role USING (user_id=auth.uid()) permits one own role row with synthetic nonexistent session context; no direct cross-user role rows
finding.not_proven: No actual revoked hosted JWT or Data API request was used; this is SQL RLS evaluation only.
finding.minimum_fix_candidate: Add private.current_session_active() to users_can_read_own_role self-read RLS policy only after isolated authorized regression proves active Owner, Reporter, MFA, and admin role reads are unaffected.
